tool_args.prompt: Create ONE complete isolated Armadura from ORIGINAL Resident Evil 4 (2005), using the EXACT black-and-gold armor variant in the FOREGROUND CENTER of the first attached image. The second attached gameplay image corroborates that same black/gold variant only. Exclude all the silver background knights, Leon, HUD, walls and scenery. Output exactly one armor enemy, not the source group. Match the black/dark metal plates, subdued worn gold trim and central gold strips, the CLOSED narrow cylindrical helmet with its source gold cross-shaped visor details, the red plume, angular broad shoulder plates, long segmented leg armor and pointed armored shoes. No exposed human head, parasite, glowing eyes, skin, animal features or new fantasy ornament. Preserve this variant's long reddish-brown wooden shaft and its complete axe/halberd head: the source forward spear point and broad curved lower axe blade. Do not replace it with a sword, spear alone, shield, double-headed fantasy axe or the silver variant's weapon. Preserve the source two-handed horizontal hold at lower chest/waist height: anatomical RIGHT gauntlet toward the blade/head and anatomical LEFT gauntlet farther back toward the shaft butt, coherent arms and wrists. Make a new physically turned SCREEN-LEFT side-dominant three-quarter ready stance, helmet, chest and armored feet aimed LEFT and the axe head projecting LEFT. Keep the original slightly angular textured game-model appearance rather than a polished remake or new medieval design. Show exactly two legs and two arms; both feet, the entire plume, every shaft endpoint and the entire axe blade must be inside the canvas with at least 10 percent transparent margin around the WHOLE combined silhouette. Scale character and weapon together to fit. True clean transparent alpha, no floor or backdrop shadows, glow, labels, text, watermark, border, UI, extra knight, second subject or animation sheet. This is a single independently generated static candidate with inferred unseen surfaces, not a mirrored image or certified original mesh.
